Rare.name: Armageddon Knight
Rare.desc: When this card is Summoned: You can send 1 DARK monster from your Deck to the GY.

Rare.name: Crush Card Virus
Rare.desc: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 1000 or less ATK; your opponent takes no damage until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, also, you look at your opponent's hand and all monsters they control, and if you do, destroy the monsters among them with 1500 or more ATK, then your opponent can destroy up to 3 monsters with 1500 or more ATK in their Deck.

Rare.name: Grandmaster of the Six Samurai
Rare.desc: You can only control 1 "Grandmaster of the Six Samurai". If you control a "Six Samurai" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: Target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand.

Rare.name: Rescue Cat
Rare.desc: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast monsters from your Deck, but their effects are negated, also they are destroyed during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Cat" once per turn.

Rare.name: Satellite Cannon
Rare.desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 7 or lower monster. During each of your End Phases: This card gains 1000 ATK. If this card attacks, this increased ATK returns to 0, after damage calculation.

Super Rare.name: Black Whirlwind
Super Rare.desc: When a "Blackwing" monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can add 1 "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand with less ATK than that monster.

Super Rare.name: Garoth, Lightsworn Warrior
Super Rare.desc: Each time a card(s) is sent from your Deck to the GY by the effect of a "Lightsworn" monster you control, except "Garoth, Lightsworn Warrior": Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY, then draw 1 card for each "Lightsworn" monster sent to the GY by this effect.

Super Rare.name: Gladiator Beast Samnite
Super Rare.desc: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, when this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, you can add 1 "Gladiator Beast" card from your Deck to your hand. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked, you can return it to the Deck to Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Samnite".

Super Rare.name: Krebons
Super Rare.desc: When this card is targeted for an attack: You can pay 800 LP; negate the attack.

Common.name: Book of Moon
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

Common.name: D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation
Common.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 of your banished monsters; Special Summon it in Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

Common.name: Gladiator Beast Bestiari
Common.desc: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Bestiari".

Common.name: Gladiator Beast Laquari
Common.desc: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, its original ATK becomes 2100. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Laquari".

Common.name: Gladiator Beast Murmillo
Common.desc: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster: Target 1 face-up monster; destroy that target. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Murmillo".

Common.name: Golden Flying Fish
Common.desc: You can Tribute 1 other Fish-Type monster, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Hand Destruction
Common.desc: Each player sends 2 cards from their hand to the GY, then draws 2 cards.

Common.name: Ryko, Lightsworn Hunter
Common.desc:
FLIP: Apply these effects (simultaneously).
● You can destroy 1 card on the field.
● Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the GY.

Common.name: Terraforming
Common.desc: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

Ultra Rare.name: Doomcaliber Knight
Ultra Rare.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If a monster effect is activated (Quick Effect): Tribute this face-up card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

Ultimate Rare.name: Judgment Dragon
Ultimate Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 4 or more "Lightsworn" monsters with different names in your GY. You can pay 1000 LP; destroy all other cards on the field. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Send the top 4 cards of your Deck to the GY.
